name: CT secondary shorting-test boundary
summary: Marks the purpose of the assigned shorting facilities at a CT test boundary.
description: Marks the purpose of the assigned shorting facilities at a CT test boundary. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “CT secondary and test device” at the input and “Defined shorting boundary” at the output. Actual operation follows the test-device instructions.
